info.title: Ellipse API
info.description: Ellipse User Access Management API. In Development, identity defaults to Security:DevAdUsername (DEV\ellipse.dev) with bootstrap admin roles. Use Authorize → AdUsername to override with header X-AD-Username.

AdUsername.description: Active Directory username for testing, e.g. DEV\ellipse.dev. Leave empty to use the Development fallback identity.
AdUsername.name: X-AD-Username
